profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 9+ years of experience always looking for better ways to create things.

I consider myself a passionate individual for cutting edge technologies, and with great desire to learn new ways of solving problems and developing new solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Apache Kafka · Ruby · MLOps · Django · PostgreSQL · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Activities.

    Research and development of new features spanning several teams and services
    Design of external and internal APIs
    Architectural designs
    Team Lead
    Mentoring
    Spear head new ways to improve system stability and service upgrades
    Being glue

Achievements

    Design and implementation of third party ACH transfers using NACHA files and finite state machines
    Work on a next day credit card disbursement system in conjunction with the ACH transfer system
    Work on ledger systems to maintain users balance and manage the lifecycle of balance disbursement or collections
    Implement both credit card and ACH ledger systems in a production environment transferring large volumes of money on a daily basis.
    Implementation of key-rings and event encryption to secure persistent communication over a kafka bus
    Refactoring of brittle systems to make them more asynchronous and resilient to failures
    Designing and implementing methods to bill customers and automate the invoicing, notification and balance collection
    Gain an in-depth knowledge of the system functionality and the overall product code
    Move a majority of systems from an EC2 based deployment to a kubernetes/helm based deployment
    Working on a SAAS environment where downtime should be kept at a minimum and product evolution requires backwards compatibility
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Microservices · Apache Kafka · MySQL · Spring Framework · RESTful WebServices · Software as a Service (SaaS) · Helm (Software) · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Austin y alrededores, Texas, Estados Unidos
positions.description:
Perform on-going security testing and code review to improve software
security
RedHat/SLES/Debian and derivative Linux distributions setup and administration
Debug/Test of Web based applications.
Troubleshoot, research root cause, analyze, and resolve product issues.
Develop, review, and /​ or execute automation qualification and validation protocols.​
Maintain and enhance automated build and test infrastructure.
Develop new techniques to automate additional testing activities.
Deliver high quality scripts, applications, and tools to support core QA
function:
    - Automate tests for core application features and functionality.
    - Automate regression and failure test cases
    - Performance, load, and endurance testing.
    - Deliver high quality, well commented, test code.
    - Identify technical issues and potential software limitations
Conduct manual testing as required to ensure product delivery goals are met.

positions.title: Sr. QA Analyst
positions.description:
Create scripts for automated testing in different Linux environments.
Use boto and ansible to automate testing in the EC2 platform. 
Reproduce bugs.
Setup testing environments
Create test plans for the different products
Design performance and reliability tests.
Setup alternate environments for products.

positions.title: Developer/Sys Admin
positions.description:
ETL processes to extract data from Openbravo ERP to Infobright.
DBA of MySQL,InfoBright, Postgres databases.
Development of Openbravo Modules for automated data loads and Business Processes.
PL/SQL Queries in Postgres.
Data Transformations with Pentaho Data Integration.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
ETL Process with Pentaho Data Integration. 
System Administrator of Debian based Servers. 
MySQL DBA.
Bash Script Development for automation of processes and maintanance of servers.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Front end design of a web site with CSS/JQuery/HTML.
Linux Virtual Machines Installation and Configuration.
Support compiling and testing modules.

honors.title: Recipient of Talent Scholarship at ITESM for academic merit
